children: Onchain Lens said Wintermute holds $99.82 million in short positions and $5.12 million in long positions on Hyperliquid, while Galaxy Digital holds $26.41 million in short positions and $6.21 million in long positions. According to Odaily, the two firms together hold $126.23 million in short positions and $11.33 million in long positions. Over the past 30 days, Wintermute lost $15.3 million, and Galaxy Digital lost $5.96 million.

title: Wintermute and Galaxy Digital Hold $126.23 Million in Short Positions on Hyperliquid
